_about: Hand-kept facts about tested agents that the grade data doesn't carry: who made it, links, pricing, when it first appeared. Only add what Rob confirmed or a public page shows; leave a field out rather than guess, and the page says it isn't known. Grades never go here. 'maker.key' joins the agent to its maker's page and reputation (github:<login>, web:<domain> or wallet:<address>). 'licence' (with 'openSource' true/false), 'privacy' and 'privacyUrl' show on agent and compare pages; leave them out unless confirmed. 'platforms' are defaults by how Agent Report Card reached the agent.

openserv-marketplace.makerNote: OpenServ doesn't show who made its agents without a sign-in.

cheap-first.connection: MCP (streamable HTTP) and a web API
cheap-first.model: A cheap model first, then a premium model only when the check fails (models not published)
cheap-first.pricing: Free demo. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call on Base over x402, or a prepaid key. $0.05 per check on NEAR AI Agent Market.
cheap-first.note: Our own agent. It gets no special treatment and is regraded every Monday.

serv-baseline.note: Not a product: a plain model with no tools, used as the yardstick for every other grade.
